meta.title: DSH Git
meta.description: One clean git and GitHub surface: a single `git` tool with ten actions — clone, init, status, save, publish, sync, pr, merge, finish, prune — plus the automatic behaviour that removes the failure mode this profile kept hitting. A few seconds after a turn's edits stop, the paths this session recorded are committed — anything else dirty is reported, not swept in — and pushed when the branch is safe to push, so nothing is left dirty or unsynced because a session forgot. A guard watches the agent's `bash` and `pwsh` calls and redirects the everyday flow (`git add`, `commit`, `push`, `pull`, `fetch`, `rebase`) at the tool that does those consistently — save, publish, sync — and refuses the commands that discard work another session may still hold; everything else runs. `status` reports the worktrees git knows about and the open pull request. How to use: ask the agent for the `git` tool, or type /git in the composer to print the working tree state. Auto-commit, auto-push, guard mode, branch prefix, protected branches and timeouts are set by overriding this bundle's row in the profile's own patch layer. Needs the dsh-git-core bundle, installed first.
